title: More checks for custom op registration
bug_description:
https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/26378 happens since the custom op registration violates one assumption: outputs of custom operators are not allowed to be views of any of the inputs.

We need proper checks to make sure the custom op registration API is used correctly, as discussed [here](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/26378#issuecomment-3385771774) by @zou3519.
